page: Amazon Web Services c6gd.medium is an ARM64-based compute-optimized server instance powered by a dedicated AWS Graviton processor using the Neoverse-N1 microarchitecture. It features 1 physical core with 1 thread, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The CPU is equipped with 64 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. The instance is configured with 2.0 GB of system memory and includes 59 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage. It runs on the AWS Nitro hypervisor.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the single-core stress-ng CPU performance is average, scoring 1490.59. However, due to its single-core configuration, multi-core benchmarks such as stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core fall into the lower performance tiers. Memory bandwidth is also constrained, with read-only large block speeds at 20.1 GB/sec and write speeds at 9.8 GB/sec. Cryptographic and compression tasks show lower relative performance, with a Passmark CPU encryption score of 131.59 and single-threaded gzip compression at 19.76 GB/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c6gd.medium offers a low-cost entry point into ARM-based compute-optimized architecture with bundled high-speed local NVMe storage. This makes it suitable for lightweight, single-threaded workloads, basic static web serving, and development or testing environments that require local scratch space but do not demand high memory capacity or multi-threaded processing power.
